findings.title: Mid-loop async insertion overwrites a protected blocking result
findings.mechanism: addUserMessage replaces pending input; incoming async receipt checks do not protect an existing blocking result with failed storage.
findings.fix: Preserve complete pending call/result groups before async insertion; reject before mutation/queue consumption if retention is impossible. Audit owned continuation after interrupted input.

findings.title: Omitting optional ToolResult.outcome drops failed-evidence protection
findings.mechanism: Context metadata is derived exclusively from outcome.evidence even when an authentic standalone evidence delivery is supplied.
findings.fix: Carry internal authentic delivery provenance and derive retention/recovery metadata without making outcome mandatory.

findings.title: Explicit save/load of an interrupted run omits pending unacknowledged observations
findings.mechanism: getState serializes committed conversation only; pending raw tool results are absent from a successful FileContextStorage snapshot.
findings.fix: Capture protected pending groups in a detached saved view with original IDs/receipts; prefer folding into the existing conversation snapshot over a new required session field.
